transcript.text: hoover washer drier showing EO3 wont drain, ive done the filter its clean. H3DS4965DACE. pump just buzzes. do i need a new pump??

A buzzing sound usually means the pump motor is trying to run but cannot turn the impeller. The most likely cause is that a small object (like a coin, button, or hair tie) has fallen past the filter and is jamming the impeller inside the pump housing itself. If the impeller is stuck, the motor buzzes but cannot drain; if it spins freely but still doesn't drain when powered, the pump motor itself may have failed. Please unplug the machine first, then check if you can turn that impeller by hand.
ok turned the impeller by finger with power off, it spins totally freely, no resistance at all, feels like its not connected to anything. torch shows one fin looks snapped

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump (jammed or failed)]
Yes, you need a new drain pump. Since I cannot verify the exact part number for your specific Hoover model via this tool, please search for "Hoover H3DS4965DACE drain pump" on the manufacturer's official spares site or a reputable UK parts supplier to ensure you get the correct replacement. Once fitted, clear any debris that may have caused the breakage and run a drain test.
ok but is the pump a separate part from the filter housing on this one? dont want to order the wrong thing. my meter reads about 170 ohms on the pump coil if that helps confirm it

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump (jammed or failed)]
The 170 ohms reading suggests the motor coil is electrically intact; the problem is purely mechanical because the impeller fin is snapped and no longer connected to the shaft. Regarding your question on whether it is separate: on most Hoover washer-dryers of this type, the drain pump is a distinct unit bolted or clipped onto the bottom of the sump/filter housing. You typically need to remove the back panel (or sometimes the front kickplate) to access the pump and disconnect its wiring and hose clamps to replace it as a separate component. I recommend sourcing a replacement drain pump for model H3DS4965DACE from a reputable UK supplier. If you are not comfortable removing the panels or handling water connections, please call an engineer.
